scope: Actual ROOT views of all five initial native pixels and all five selected usage720 files; nonblind, unscored and no actor feedback.
observations: All five selected members keep a prominent headline/companion language followed by slogan and explanation, ending in adjoining divided practical groups. The image field changes more than the information structure.
M1 separates upper triptych from lower centered information slab. The long sentence occupies one wide line at720.
M2 uses paper/wood/textile shapes and hands around a central paragraph and lower practical pair; source-copy typography is more stable than the fine serif initially used on textured carriers.
M3 reduces headline and enlarges body, but the painted central table remains the hosting field for a closely shared text arrangement.

M4 changes brush headline, episode montage and left chair scale; fee joins event group while deadline marks the neighboring right group. Its scene changes are substantive but copy structure remains related.
M5 reduces large paired title/English lines and enlarges body, yet leaves a central jagged pale information island between enlarged wood and textile crops.
